notes.title: Nation Pack: Italy's Release Date!
notes.notes:
Commanders, rejoice!

We are the bringer of good news. Our latest expansion, [b]Nation Pack: Italy[/b], will release into the wild - and in your eager hands - [i]soon[/i]!
Sooner than you think ...

Read on for more details.

[b][h2]Nation Pack: Italy coming soon[/h2][/b]

Celebrating [i]Wargame Red Dragon[/i] with [b]Nation Pack: Italy[/b], our major new expansion. At long last, it introduces the much requested Italian armed forces to WRD, with a host of new units, voice acting, models, and more.
It will be released on [b]August 29th[/b], that his next Thursday! And as usual, i will be accompanied by a [b]major balance patch[/b] AND a [b]reboot of the ranked[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/3a9d34a0bcd6e1e3e2461fb2b73ef8c1ced0409d.png[/img]

[b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: Italy[/b] will feature Italy as a stand-alone NATO nation in [b]Wargame: Red Dragon[/b]. They will bring their unique mix of domestic and foreign materiel to the battlefield, old and brand-spanking new. Fully voiced and featuring 104 new Italian units, 19 new models, many existing models redone or upgraded, and a score of new variants, [b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: Italy[/b] will boast one of the most visually up-to-date arsenals of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/2c359d2dbc2724625ec845add636aab83f70920c.png[/img]

In the previous DevBlogs, we detailed the upcoming new Italian infantry. Read [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/251060/view/4364635226643091531?l=english]all the juicy details here[/url]. We also previewed the new and striking Italian vehicles of the Nation Pack, which you can check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/251060/view/4364635860619082129?l=english]out the DevBlog here[/url]. And the last DevBlog details the Italian flying craft. Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/251060/view/4364636495674984644?l=english]all the details here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/0226453542469fcd650f0aecfb07c81fe405cbea.png[/img]

We are also closing the "Enlist in the Italian Army" form from this moment, in order to clean the list from all the playwords and derogatory nicknames we're sure some have introduced (don't try to deny), then include it in the final version version of the game.
In the meantime, until release next Thursday, some members of the WRD community who have helped us test and balance the DLC will now start streaming videos of the new Italian nations, for your perspective.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025360/Wargame_Red_Dragon__Nation_Pack_Italy/

[b][h2]See you very soon![/h2][/b]

If you want to be kept appraised of all the latest Eugen has to offer, be sure to check out our ([url=https://www.facebook.com/eugensystems/]Facebook[/url] page and [url=https://x.com/EugenSystems]Twitter[/url]).

Ciao!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/8c2edf00b4a2e64ca88c7d705d6c936ac3c2d334.gif[/img]

notes.title: Nation Pack - SADF Post-Summer Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, we are back again! 

Now, you might wonder what we have been up to in August. Not sitting quietly, that’s for sure. 

The release of our new [b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: South Africa[/b] DLC is getting closer. But before we get there, we wanted to highlight what we have been working on. 

[b][h2]Active development[/h2][/b] 
A special team has been chipping away and testing the [b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: South Africa[/b] for a month. Thanks to their hard work and dedication, we have rebalanced and tweaked the SADF forces in-game, and made sure the new arsenal is as polished as can be. Such as?

Some of the plane load-outs have been changed compared to ones detailed in our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/251060/view/2993187041046213532
]South African Air Force Gameplay[/url][/b] post.

We have reworked some of the models and we are continuing our balancing efforts. This also means that [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/251060/view/2994315478659361278]the balance patch we previously promised[/url][/b] for the base game has grown significantly in size and scope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/3259ae616b6d66e1ead36b9f1b5dd2c6c26234bb.jpg[/img]

There is more, though! 

[b][h2]New units[/h2][/b]
Based on the team’s feedback, we have added two new units to the roster. 

[list]
[*][b]Ratel 90 FSV[/b]. An additional [b]Ratel 90[/b] version. A non-transport variant classified as a fire support vehicle in the VHC tab. 
[*]A new [b]Cheetah variant[/b], bringing the total to four: C, D, D2, and E. This will replace one of the previous Mirage models, which happened to be incorrect ([i]Mirage IIIE2Z[/i]).  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/a290a809ca6708eea4f47552f7a1cda513f84fd2.png[/img]

[b][h2]What will the South Africa Nation Pack bring?[/h2][/b] 
[b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: South Africa[/b] will feature:

[list]
[*]Close to 90 new SADF units, including 20 brand-new vehicle models, as well as many new variants. All feature new Afrikaans and South African-accented English voice-overs.
[*]These include the ubiquitous [b]Casspir[/b] and [b]Ratel[/b] APCs (in numerous variants, from IFV, recon, command, mortar, and even SAM), the [b]Rooikat[/b] wheeled tank (including variants and prototypes), [b]Eland[/b] (license-produced French AML), [b]Cactus[/b] (French Crotale), the only tracked [b]Olifant[/b] MBT, many armed variants of locally made [b]SAMIL[/b] trucks ([b]Ystervark[/b] and [b]Bosvark[/b] SPAAG, [b]Valkiri[/b] and [b]Bateleur[/b] MLRS), to the iconic [b]G6 Renoster[/b] self-propelled howitzer. 
[*]The Air Force includes old [b]Buccaneer[/b], [b]Vampire[/b] and [b]Impala[/b] as close-air support, and several French [b]Mirage[/b] variants and the local [b]Cheetah[/b] as fighter and multirole aircraft. Furthermore, you will find the [b]Atlas Carver[/b] prototype, the first full South African prototype plane design (which never left the drawing board). 
[*]Helicopters include the French [b]Alouette III[/b], [b]Puma[/b], [b]Super Frelon[/b] and their domestically produced versions and prototypes such as the [b]K-Car[/b], [b]Oryx[/b] and [b]XTP-1 Beta[/b]. You’ll also be able to deploy South Africa’s very own attack helicopter design, the badass-looking [b]Rooivalk[/b]. 
[*]Infantry will include [b]Bokkop[/b] regular riflemen, [b]Parabat[/b] paratroopers, [b]SASF[/b] special forces, and many more units such as militia, recon, MANPADS, engineers. You will find Portuguese-speaking Angolan [b]UNITA[/b] squads, as well as SADF’s own [b]32 Battalion[/b] (the Buffalos) as a veteran light infantry formation. 
[*]SADF weaponry features imported or locally built [b]R1[/b] and [b]R4[/b] rifles, [b]SS-77[/b] and [b]Mini-SS[/b] MG, [b]LRAC[/b] and [b]APILAS[/b] LAW, but also the more original [b]HK-21[/b], [b]FT5[/b], [b]Inflict[/b] and, of course, the iconic [b]Y2 grenade-launcher[/b] and [b]NTW-20[/b].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/552e0d52235d183659d3fda8fb32bbe4bcdd038a.png[/img]

[b][h2]What happens next?[/h2][/b]

For now, that’s it. We hope to come back to you shortly with a release date for our new DLC. Hang in tight! 

To stay in touch, check out our [url=https://forums.eugensystems.com/viewforum.php?f=216]Eugen forums[/url], or ([url=https://www.facebook.com/eugensystems/]Facebook[/url] page and [url=https://twitter.com/EugenSystems]Twitter[/url])! 

See you soon!

notes.title: WRD - Nation Pack: SADF General Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are back with a much-needed update about our upcoming 
[b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: South Africa[/b] DLC. We know you are longing to play our new [b]Nation Pack[/b], but we are still some ways off before our upcoming expansion is ready to be released. 

[i]What? Why? When?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/1165249a9bb8ce1593bba2e6fb45cc5d8a0c31ff.gif[/img]

Keep reading to find out.

[b][h2]A mea culpa[/h2][/b] 
Game development is hard, and the way to any kind of launch is beset with roadblocks and detours. We know that some of you were hoping for a release soon - as in next week soon - or alternatively sometime in August. That is, unfortunately, not going to happen. 

We still need more time with [b]Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: South Africa[/b]. Even though unit balancing is done, as most of the unit models, there is plenty of work left. Not only that, August is a very quiet month in which everything slows down. We try to avoid releasing anything in the deepest part of the summer holidays. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5756781/b5721ffa6f03183eba85a748d6642cb894ec0414.png[/img]

There is more: next to [b]Wargame: Red Dragon[/b], we are also working concurrently on two new expansions for or our [i]other[/i] popular strategy game (you might have heard about it here or there) [b]Steel Division 2[/b]. In all fairness, we bit off more than we could chew, and coupled with the small delays that are always encountered, a post-August launch of the [b]Nation Pack[/b] seems ever more likely. Our apologies! 

[b][h2]An updated roadmap[/h2][/b] 
When we get close to the launch, we’ll let you know. Until then, we don’t want to leave you completely empty-handed. Some new details:

[list]
[*]Most models are now done. You can see new preview screens of several major units - many of them we haven’t shown previously!
